A part of a complete circuit is shown in the figure. At some instant, the value of current I is 1A and it is decreasing at a rate
of 102 A s–1. The value of the potential difference VP – VQ , (in volts) at that instant, is _________.
en.explanation:
VP + L. - 30 + 2i = VQ

VP + 50 10-3(-102) - 30 + 21 = VQ

VP - VQ = 35 - 2 = 33
